summary: AFFiNE Community Edition is a self-hosted knowledge base and workspace combining document editing, planning, and visual brainstorming into a single interface. It serves as an open-source alternative to proprietary platforms like Notion and Miro with a focus on local data control. The software allows you to organise notes, structured tables, and whiteboards within one environment.
goodFor: It suits teams or individuals seeking a privacy-focused, customisable workspace for documentation and visual collaboration without relying on cloud services.
watchOut: The project uses a split licence structure including AGPL-3.0, and because it aims to replace multiple complex tools, it may have a steeper resource footprint and operational learning curve.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based deployment, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
